## About this round

Company-reported: Trade Lenda co-founder and CEO Adeshina Adewumi said that, following the Village Capital / Africa Ecosystem Catalysts Facility investment (funding 1507235), the company 'secured an additional USD 2M in local debt facilities at lower rates' (quote in Village Capital's press release dated 7 Sep 2026; reported by TechCabal 3 Sep 2026). Aggregate of unitemized facilities recorded once; lenders, individual facility amounts, terms and closing dates are not disclosed. date\_announced = earliest public report (TechCabal, 2026-09-03), not a closing or disbursement date. Not independently verified beyond the company statement. Separate from and not included in funding 1507235.
